checks.statement: all quotient dimensions obey the finite-width law
omitting the grade-two correction fails first at the known target circuit

verdict: The a-indexed current classes grow one per pole depth until a finite width D_(g,q), with a unique extra direction when (g,q)=(2,5) targets the known grade-two Q=7 exceptional circuit. An unbounded triangular proof remains open.
